newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana approves $148.12 million of bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana approves $148.12 million of bond issues.

text.p: Louisiana Bond Commission gave final approval Thursday to eight state and local government bond issues totaling $148.12 million.
--$43.5 million Louisiana Public Facilities Authority student loan revenue bonds, to provide low-interst loans.
--$30 million City of New Orleans sewarge service revenue bonds, for construction of sewerage treatment plants and other improvements.
--$29 million Louisiana Public Facilities Authority revenue refunding bonds, to refund the Xavier University of Louisiana Project for housing and dormitory services.
--$20 million East Baton Rouge Mortgage Finance Authority single family revene bonds to fund first-time loans to moderate income buyers.
--$14 million Metropolitan Council of Baton Rouge Parish and the City of Baton Rouge, public improvement sales tax bonds to finance improments at the Ryan Airport terminal.
--$9.5 million City of Bossier public improvement refunding bonds, to refund its Public Improvement Bonds Series ST-1989.
--$1.85 million Town of Vivian revenue refunding bonds, to refund its Utilities Revenue Bonds Series 1987.
--$270,000 Union Parish Waterworks District No. 1, water revenue bonds for system improvements and extensions.
